response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), film_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS total_films FROM film_actor), shares AS (SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, ac.film_count / ft.total_films AS film_share FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN film_total ft) SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_share, film_share - AVG(film_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, actor_id LIMIT 10
